_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for display encoding shared by backend (Python) and frontend (TypeScript). Backend reads this to fill ScoredVessel display hints; frontend reads it (mirrored in TS) to render. Do not drift the two consumers apart — change here, regenerate/mirror in both. See shared/encoding/README.md.

ship_type_to_shape._comment: Maps the normalized ShipType enum -> a deck.gl-friendly icon/shape key. 'triangle' points along COG for moving vessels; 'square'/'diamond' etc. are static glyphs.

suspicion_color_stops._comment: Piecewise-linear color ramp from suspicion 0.0 (calm) -> 1.0 (hot). Each stop is [score, [r,g,b]]. Consumers interpolate between adjacent stops. Tuned for a dark ops basemap: cool blue -> teal -> amber -> red.

suspicion_bands._comment: Discrete bands for legends / alert-feed grouping. [min_inclusive, max_exclusive] except the top band which is inclusive of 1.0.

sensor_colors._comment: Color per recommended sensor for the cueing overlay boxes.
